scope: Regional ambient moths: additional small living scenery using existing supported vegetation. This pass does not change gameplay collision, combat, saves or progression.

notes: Six original wing poses per region share registered thorax pivots and fixed scale, avoiding whole-body resizing with wing extent.
Whole swept orbit/retreat volumes clear native solid geometry and interaction reservations; groups use existing supported floor vegetation only.
Late walls, disabled/restored floor support and freed habitat are revalidated without changing native colliders. Stable reentry retains group identity.
Player passage eases moths away, then they recover while stationary. Contact does not teleport them or emit a grass-particle burst.
All groups share four source sheets and 24 cached atlas regions. No runtime source-image alpha scans or per-frame texture loads.
Room changes and warps clear contact response. Culled groups settle, hidden/removed habitat hides its insects.

verification.source_hashes: All four workspace PNG SHA256 values match their original built-in ImageGen outputs; see manifest.

notes: Actual player controller walks through each habitat; static terrain collision stays enabled.
Room simulation and enemy/area collision are frozen in previews to isolate the scenery, not in production.
Reviewed all twelve frames for scale, framing, transparency, habitat position and regional contrast. Ash moths intentionally remain subdued against warm backgrounds.

editor_import.notes: Sandbox denied saving global Godot editor settings outside the workspace.

limitations: Focused regression selection, not a complete suite, full campaign, exported-build certification or physical-device/FPS benchmark.
No full-game art completion or complete NPC/boss animation overhaul is claimed in this continuation.
The shared animation cap counts props/groups; contact responses keep their separate pre-existing 12/6 limit.
Windows root-certificate warning remains; native previews report sandbox shader-cache write denials rather than shader compilation errors.
Run folders/logs are ignored local artifacts; source/tests/report and reviewed screenshots are versioned.
